title: Celestial Menagerie
summary: A dark fantasy storefront built with React, Vite, TypeScript and Material UI. A polished multi-page SPA for a fictional marketplace of mythological creatures, magical supplies, arcane habitats and guild memberships, with custom theming, routing, responsive layouts and bilingual support.
imageAlt: Preview of Celestial Menagerie, a dark fantasy storefront with a catalog of magical creatures
